verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical: in both, 'JULY 29' is crammed into a tiny two-line stack beside the headline, so it loses its role as a lead-in, and the short red divider floats alone with nothing near it. A also leaves a large dead gap between the headline and the illustration while the headline sits close to the top. B moves the whole block down, which spreads the space more evenly, but it pushes the illustration close to the 'FOR BEGINNERS'/GROVE.ONLINE footer row.
